QuestInfo.1: You've met a strangely dressed man named Black M-Forcer near Omega Sector. He asked you to eliminate #r70#k #rBarnard Grays#k in Kulan Field.

0.0: Every day, we devote everything to defeat the aliens, but the number seems to be increasing by day. I don't think I've gotten weaker, you know. Maybe there's a force of evil controlling them... Anyway, I would love to reach out for your help. Would you like to at least listen to the whole story?

yes.0: Thank you. I simply can't handle all of these aliens myself. That is why I'd like for you to reduce their numbers. Can you take care of #r70#k aliens called #r#o4230116##k in Kulan Field?
yes.1: They are the weakest among the Grays, so that shouldn't be too much of a problem. Grays are very class-driven, and the lowest guys actually approach the Omega Sector as close as they can possibly get. Please take care of them, and then come back to me, okay? Best of luck to you!

no.0: Really...? I understand. Everyone seems to get a tad hesitant when dealing with ugly aliens like them. If you ever change your mind, however, I'll be right here.

1.0: I'm amazed that you managed to handle 70 of those violent #b#o4230116##k aliens! You've exceeded my expectations. Did they manage to push their invasion near by Omega Sector, though...? Anyway, I must reward you for your work. Please, take it!

yes.0: Did you get 50 of those #b#t2001002##k things? That's my way of saying thank you. But I think now's the time to analyze and tackle the root of the problem. Your help might be needed again in the future, so please come visit me whenever you have the time!

mob.0: Ah,  you haven't completed the task yet. Come back after defeating 70 of the #b#o4230116##k aliens near Kulan Field.
